Result tables array is empty when input has no tables

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"include_document_structure\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>No tables here</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.tables())
```
